description: This file defines the SaveProjectController class in the OrangeHRM Time Plugin, responsible for handling project saving functionality, permission checks, and pre-render setup for project-related views within the HRM system.

classes.name: SaveProjectController
classes.description: Controller for handling project save operations, including preparing the view component and access control based on project existence and user permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component for project editing or creation, attaches necessary properties based on project ID, and sets permissions.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permissions to access or modify the project identified by the request; throws exception if project not found.
